g.text: Every localization lands where its piece of tissue is at the end. For D, the local stretch still to come (Jₜ) is taken back out:
linked in the final geometry, a step between neighbouring frames would be stretched by it, and D inflated by (1 + ε)².

g.text: Φₖ(p) = p + (g₀ + g₁s + g₂s² + g₃n) a + (h₀ + h₁s + h₂n) m
Snapshot k onto the last one's geometry: an affine map (6 numbers)
plus the one quadratic term a growing root needs. s, n: position along
and across the root axis, from the field centre.
The growth model: seven numbers per snapshot
